nodes.description: uint256 private maxColor = 2**24; upper bound for valid token IDs (24-bit color space).
uint private lastTokenId; mutable seed used by the pseudo-random nextTokenId generator.
uint256 public publicPrice = 0.01 ether; price required to mint via mintHex.
bytes alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEF"; hex alphabet used to build alphabetMap.
mapping (bytes1 => uint) alphabetMap; maps hex character to its numeric nibble value for hexToDec.
Color constructor: initializes ERC721 name/symbol, Ownable, lastTokenId = 0 and populates alphabetMap.
mintHex(string) external payable: validates msg.value >= publicPrice, converts hex input to a token ID and claims it.
mint() external: derives a token ID from nextTokenId and loops until an unminted ID is found, then claims it.
ownerClaim(uint256) public nonReentrant onlyOwner: owner-only mint of a specific token ID after bounds validation.
tokenURI(uint256) public pure: builds the on-chain SVG/JSON metadata data URI for a color token ID.
hexToDec(string) internal view: decodes the first 6 hex characters into a uint256 using alphabetMap shifts.
claimById(uint256) internal nonReentrant: bounds-checks the ID then safely mints it to _msgSender().
nextTokenId() internal: linear congruential generator over lastTokenId modulo maxColor.
msg.sender (via _msgSender()); caller of mint/mintHex and the recipient/callback target of _safeMint in claimById.
_safeMint(_msgSender(), tokenId) in claimById: external call to onERC721Received on an attacker-controlled receiver.
_safeMint(owner(), tokenId) in ownerClaim: external ERC721Receiver callback to the current owner address.
Payable value handling in mintHex: reads msg.value for the publicPrice check with no refund of excess value.
string memory hexStr parameter of mintHex.
uint256 tokenId parameter of ownerClaim.
uint256 tokenId parameter of tokenURI.
local uint256 tokenId returned by hexToDec inside mintHex.
local uint256 tokenId produced by nextTokenId inside mint.
local uint m = maxColor used as modulus in nextTokenId.
local hexColor string produced by Strings.toHexString(tokenId, 3).
local uint256 res accumulated while decoding hex nibbles in hexToDec.
local bytes strBytes = bytes(hexStr) indexed in hexToDec.
local colorBox SVG string assembled from p1,p2,p3,p5 in tokenURI.

edges.reason: mintHex calls hexToDec to convert the hex string into a token ID
hexStr parameter flows into hexToDec decoding
hexToDec returns the decoded tokenId to mintHex
alphabetMap is read to map each hex character to its nibble value
hexStr is cast to bytes and stored in strBytes
strBytes elements are indexed and accumulated into res
accumulated res is returned as the decoded token ID
mintHex forwards the decoded ID to claimById
local tokenId computed in mintHex is passed into claimById
publicPrice is compared against msg.value in mintHex
mintHex reads msg.value to validate the payable price check
claimById bounds-checks tokenId against maxColor
claimById invokes _safeMint, which performs an external onERC721Received callback before state is fully settled
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient and thus the external callback target
_safeMint calls onERC721Received on the receiver (msg.sender), giving the caller control flow during minting
tokenId parameter is validated and minted inside ownerClaim
ownerClaim checks tokenId < maxColor
ownerClaim calls _safeMint, triggering an external ERC721 receiver callback to owner()
mint calls nextTokenId to obtain a candidate token ID
nextTokenId writes the new value into lastTokenId
lastTokenId is read as the LCG seed for the next token ID
maxColor bounds and thereby weakens the pseudo-random token ID space in nextTokenId
local m is assigned from maxColor to act as the modulus
mint calls claimById once an unminted token ID is found
local tokenId from mint is passed into claimById
tokenURI reads the tokenId parameter to render metadata
tokenId is converted into the hexColor string
hexColor local is produced inside tokenURI
hexColor is concatenated into the colorBox SVG
colorBox is base64-encoded and returned in the token URI
constructor initializes lastTokenId to 0
constructor reads the alphabet bytes to build the lookup map
constructor populates alphabetMap with each character's nibble value

normalization_plan.reason: hexStr is the user-supplied function argument of mintHex and is fully contained in it
tokenId is the only argument of ownerClaim and its usage is local to the function
tokenId is the only argument of tokenURI and drives its local string building
tokenId is a temporary value produced and consumed inside mintHex
tokenId is a temporary value produced and consumed inside mint
m is the local modulus copy of maxColor used only by nextTokenId
hexColor is an intermediate string used only when rendering metadata in tokenURI
res is the accumulator returned by hexToDec and has no independent state
strBytes is the local byte view of the hexStr argument inside hexToDec
colorBox is an intermediate SVG string assembled solely inside tokenURI
